Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building ages, sizes, portables, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and instructional priorities; includes immediate and long-term needs integrated into capital planning (Chunks 1, 18, 19).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed long-term enrollment projections with methodology; includes capacity utilization data by site and grade; connects analysis to specific facility actions including new construction, boundary changes, and consolidation; proposes adaptive uses of space and innovative programs (Chunks 1, 14-18, 24-26).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational program vision and facility standards linked to district mission; comprehensive analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including CTE, special education, collaborative learning, and technology; facility projects directly respond to educational goals (Chunks 10-14, 26-27).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: No mention or minimal reference to outdoor spaces, greening, or outdoor learning in the plan; site maps show outdoor spaces only as playgrounds or athletic fields without discussion of shade, green space, or environmental benefits (No evidence found in provided chunks).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention of climate risks, climate readiness, or mitigation strategies related to climate change impacts in the plan; emergency preparedness is not linked to climate change (No evidence found in provided chunks).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: No mention or minimal reference to energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, or energy resilience; no data on energy use or state requirements; no discussion of energy-related climate impacts (No evidence found in provided chunks).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects; includes prioritization framework and phased implementation plan; outlines multiple funding strategies including bonds, lease/lease-back, and state programs; considers long-term financial sustainability and aligns financial capacity with district priorities (Chunks 1, 27-30).
